name: China Moon Restaurant
description: The premier dining destination at Everland — China Moon is an elegant Chinese restaurant serving authentic Cantonese and Sichuan dishes including dim sum, Peking duck, stir-fry specialities and traditional Korean-Chinese fusion in a beautifully decorated atmospheric setting.

items.name: Peking Duck Set
items.description: Classic roast duck with pancakes, spring onion and hoisin sauce

items.name: Dim Sum Basket
items.description: Selection of freshly steamed Cantonese dim sum

items.name: Kung Pao Chicken
items.description: Spicy Sichuan chicken with peanuts and dried chilli

name: Cucina Mario
description: A charming Italian restaurant at Everland serving pizza, pasta and Italian classics — one of the most relaxed and family-friendly dining options in the park with generous portions and a warm atmosphere beloved by Korean families.

items.name: Tiramisu
items.description: Classic Italian tiramisu with espresso and mascarpone

name: On The Border
description: A lively Tex-Mex restaurant at Everland serving burritos, nachos, tacos and classic American-Mexican favourites — the most vibrant and energetic casual dining option at the park popular with young visitors and families.

items.name: Beef Burrito
items.description: Flour tortilla filled with seasoned beef, rice, beans and salsa

items.name: Loaded Nachos
items.description: Crispy tortilla chips with cheese, jalapenos and guacamole

items.name: Chicken Tacos
items.description: Three soft tacos with grilled chicken and fresh toppings

name: Snack Busters
description: A popular quick-service snack outlet at Everland serving Korean street food classics including corn dogs, tteokbokki, fried chicken and Korean snacks — the most authentic and beloved Korean quick-service option at the park.

items.name: Korean Corn Dog
items.description: Classic Korean-style corn dog with mozzarella filling

items.name: Tteokbokki
items.description: Spicy rice cakes in gochujang sauce

items.name: Bubble Tea
items.description: Classic milk tea with tapioca pearls
